title: What to expect after surgery
summary: A starting point for discussing your individual recovery plan.

blocks.text: Use these questions as a starting point for a conversation with your treating team.

sections.heading: Questions to ask your treating team

items: What written instructions will I receive from my treating team?
When and where will follow-up take place?
Who can I contact with concerns after discharge?

blocks.text: Follow the individual instructions provided by your treating team.
